images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 28 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light cool ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 72 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: small silver hoop earrings, a light heather gray lightweight quilted puffer jacket with thin horizontal quilting, stand collar and hip length, a soft cream white ribbed knit turtleneck, light blue wide leg denim jeans with a full straight wide leg, a small black leather shoulder bag, and a pair of black leather round toe loafers. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a young Korean woman in her late 20s wearing exactly the same items, the light gray lightweight puffer jacket worn unzipped over the cream turtleneck, light blue wide leg jeans covering the loafers, small black bag on the shoulder, standing relaxed in the middle of a quiet Seoul side street with autumn trees, only in the lower 72 percent, headless body-only composition cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft overcast daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
